description_en: Queries the backup sets of a specified application by time range and backup status, and returns the backup details in a paginated list
description_zh: 按时间范围和备份状态查询指定应用的备份集，并分页返回备份详情
name: DescribeApplicationBackups

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the application
parameters.help_zh: 应用所在地域的地域 ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The application type, such as polarclaw
parameters.name: application_type

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. This parameter is required. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC and cannot be later than the current time
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。调用时必须提供，采用 ISO 8601 格式 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ，使用 UTC 时间，不能晚于当前时间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. This parameter is required and cannot be earlier than the start time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间。调用时必须提供，且不得早于开始时间。采用 ISO 8601 格式 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ，使用 UTC 时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The filter condition for the backup status. A value of Success indicates that the backup is completed, and a value of Failed indicates that the backup failed
parameters.help_zh: 备份状态筛选条件。Success 表示备份完成，Failed 表示备份失败
parameters.name: backup_status

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 30, 50, and 100. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的记录数，取值为 30、50 或 100，默认值为 30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be an integer greater than 0 and less than or equal to 2147483647. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码。取值为大于 0 且不超过 2147483647 的整数，默认值为 1
parameters.name: page_number

Items.description_en: The list of application backup sets

BackupEndTime.description_en: The end time of the backup. The time is displayed in UTC in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
BackupEndTime.description_zh: 备份结束时间，使用 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

BackupStartTime.description_en: The start time of the backup. The time is displayed in UTC in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
BackupStartTime.description_zh: 备份开始时间，使用 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

BackupStatus.description_en: The backup status. A value of Success indicates that the backup is completed, and a value of Failed indicates that the backup failed
BackupStatus.description_zh: 备份状态。Success 表示备份完成，Failed 表示备份失败

BackupType.description_en: The backup type. A value of FullBackup indicates a full backup, and a value of IncrementalBackup indicates an incremental backup
BackupType.description_zh: 备份类型。FullBackup 表示全量备份，IncrementalBackup 表示增量备份

JobMode.description_en: The backup mode. A value of Automated indicates an automatic backup, and a value of Manual indicates a manual backup
JobMode.description_zh: 备份模式。Automated 表示自动备份，Manual 表示手动备份

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of backup sets returned on the current page
PageRecordCount.description_zh: 当前页返回的备份集数量

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of backup sets that meet the query conditions
TotalRecordCount.description_zh: 符合条件的备份集总数
